task: Add draggable MIDI export area to step sequencer RIGHT panel

feature_details.description: Add a new draggable MIDI export area on the RIGHT side of the step sequencer
requirements: New area on RIGHT panel (not left)
Area represents MIDI content from the step sequencer
User can click and drag FROM this area to external apps (DAW, file explorer)
MIDI file is saved immediately on every sequencer click
Real-time sync: marking 1 note immediately makes it available in the draggable MIDI
Visual: MIDI icon with 'Drag MIDI' label
File naming: SAMPLAR_ prefix with procedural generation
GM drum map for note pitches
Use existing tempo input from sequencer
